The club

More than
a boxing gym.

Noble Art is a local amateur boxing and fitness club for all the community, based at 111 Seamill Street, Nitshill. It is affiliated to Boxing Scotland, the sport’s governing body in Scotland — so members train in a real, recognised club, not a fitness fad.

Here you learn proper boxing — footwork, guard, punching and ring craft — and you build fitness, discipline and confidence alongside it. And Noble Art is a registered Scottish charity, run for the community, not for profit.

Founder & Head Coach — Boxing Scotland Directory

Kris McAdam

Founder & Head Coach, Noble Art Boxing Club

Kris founded Noble Art and leads the club’s coaching. He is supported by youth coordinator Kat Paton, who runs the club’s work with young people and families in Nitshill.

“
Boxing has definitely helped with my mental health — a few of the other boys in the gym say the exact same.

Andrew Meichan — Noble Art boxer, who first put gloves on at the club in 2015 and went on to win national competitions. Quoted in the Glasgow Times.

A community hub, not just a gym.

Noble Art looks after Nitshill beyond the ring. In the summer of 2019 its Summer Lunch Club fed 68 children through the school holidays, with food, diet and culture activities — work recognised in the UK Parliament.

  • Summer Lunch Club for local families
  • Homework Club for young people
  • Community garden kids & family group
  • A safe, welcoming place for the whole community
